description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Twin Element Mode (Wind, Poison) v2], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Thief (I)], [Apex Hollow Blast Damage Tracker] and [Apex Hollow Blast Level]

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Wind, Poison) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind]/[Attach Poison] after using a Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Thief (I)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Hollow Blast (0~2), removed after using Apex Hollow Blast two times

description.name: Apex Hollow Blast Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Hollow Blast level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Thief (I)]

description.name: Apex Hollow Blast Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Hollow Blast level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Thief (I)]
